whenNotToUse.when: Picking a span of days with a start and an end

guidance.bestFor: A from and to span in one month, seeded as today through 5 days later

guidance.bestFor: Range picking that blocks past days, today, weekends and 2 spans, restarting any range that crosses one
agentNotes: No `selected` state is wired, so the chosen range stays inside `Calendar` and nothing can read it
The 2 blocked spans in `disabled` are sample dates 14 to 16 and 23 to 24 days out; swap in real blackout dates

guidance.bestFor: Separate days toggled on and off one by one, seeded with 4 dates around today

whenNotToUse.when: Consecutive days picked as one span rather than one by one

guidance.bestFor: Fully round day buttons for a single pick, forced with one classNames override on the day button

whenNotToUse.when: Round day styling on a span with a start and an end

guidance.bestFor: A from and to span with every day button forced round, the range counterpart of the circular single pick
agentNotes: The `range-start` and `range-end` selectors in `classNames` match no element in react-day-picker 9, so the half filled band never draws
Overriding `day` in `classNames` replaces the Calendar day classes, dropping the `group/day` hook its focused day ring needs

guidance.bestFor: The month title moved to the left edge with both arrows grouped on the right, through classNames
Far past days reached through month and year Select menus that replace the arrows, from July 1980 on
agentNotes: The year menu starts at the July 1980 `startMonth` and, with no end month passed, stops at the current year
`handleCalendarChange` wraps the Select value in a fake change event for the `onChange` each react-day-picker dropdown hands over

whenNotToUse.when: A year jump that keeps the month arrows and shows the month name as text

guidance.bestFor: A year Select beside the month name in the caption, with the previous and next arrows kept
agentNotes: Years run from the July 1980 `startMonth` to the end of this year, and the next arrow stops there as well

whenNotToUse.when: Month and year both chosen from menus, with no arrows at all

guidance.bestFor: Week numbers in a leading column through a custom WeekNumber cell, with 6 rows in every month
An outline button under the grid that brings the view back to this month without changing the pick

whenNotToUse.when: A reset that should also select today, not only show its month

guidance.bestFor: A reset button that selects today and jumps to it, with the grid opening 4 weeks back
A caption button that swaps the grid for a year list, then a month list, spanning 10 years either side of today
agentNotes: `startYear` and `endYear` fix the range at 10 years before and after today; widen both for older or later dates

guidance.bestFor: Half hour slots from 09:00 to 17:30 in a scrolling column beside the grid, with taken slots and past days disabled
agentNotes: `timeSlots` is mock availability, identical for every day; load the real slots for the chosen `date`
The chosen `time` lives in local state only and resets to null on each new day; nothing submits it

whenNotToUse.when: An hour and minute value chosen freely rather than from fixed slots

guidance.bestFor: A rail of Today, Yesterday, Last week, Last month and Last year shortcuts for one past day, with future days blocked

whenNotToUse.when: Shortcuts into the coming days, such as Tomorrow or 2 weeks out

guidance.bestFor: Range presets such as Last 7 days, Month to date and Last year that set both ends and jump the view there

whenNotToUse.when: A span shortcut rail that opens from a field in a popover

guidance.bestFor: A price under every day from a seeded formula, green below $100, with large cells and no outside days
agentNotes: `getPriceForDate` derives a fake price from the date itself; swap in your real rates per day

guidance.bestFor: Forward shortcuts Today, Tomorrow, 3 days, Week and 2 weeks as a footer button row in a compact card
agentNotes: The initial `date` is fixed to 12 February this year, while `currentMonth` opens on the current month

whenNotToUse.when: Shortcuts back to past days, such as Yesterday or Last year

guidance.bestFor: A titled booking card with 15 minute slots from 09:00 to 18:00, today and 2 more days taken, and a summary line by Confirm
agentNotes: `bookedDates` blocks today and the next 2 days as sample data; fill it from your real bookings
The Confirm `Button` has no handler, and the footer already says booked once a day and `selectedTime` are set

whenNotToUse.when: Many booked appointments viewed across a week, not one slot being picked

guidance.bestFor: A single day pick across 2 months shown side by side, stacking into one column below md

whenNotToUse.when: A start and end span stretched across the 2 months

guidance.bestFor: A range across 2 side by side months, preset from the 6th to the 18th of this month

whenNotToUse.when: A range kept closed behind a field until someone opens it

guidance.bestFor: A compact card listing events under the grid with colored bars, time spans and an Add Event button
agentNotes: `events` holds 3 fixed January 2026 entries and ignores the selected `date`, so the list never changes
The Add Event `Button` has no handler; wire it to your own create flow

whenNotToUse.when: A full month or week view where entries are dragged and resized

guidance.bestFor: A language Select in the header that switches day names, month titles and the heading between English and Chinese
agentNotes: The `locale` ternary maps every key except zh to `enUS`, so a new `localizedStrings` language needs its own locale import
`dateRange` starts on fixed sample dates, 9 to 17 February 2026, and the grid opens on that month

guidance.bestFor: An outline trigger reading Pick a date that opens one month in a popover and then shows the long formatted day
agentNotes: `Popover` stays open after a day is picked; close it from `onSelect` through a controlled open state

whenNotToUse.when: A filter that also offers before, after and between operators

guidance.bestFor: A trigger reading Pick a date range that opens 2 months in a popover and prints both ends once chosen

whenNotToUse.when: A range field that also needs one click shortcuts such as Last 30 days
Filtering by month, quarter or year periods as well as day spans
